id="-tBO2DgtPleyKCgmbG-t-3" value="STAR make index" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="100" y="210" width="120" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="-tBO2DgtPleyKCgmbG-t-4" value="<div>STAR --runMode genomeGenerate \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--genomeDir ./STAR_151bpindex_hg38/ \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--genomeFastaFiles ./ref/hg38.fa \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--sjdbGTFfile ./ref/gencode.v26.annotation.gtf&nbsp; \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--sjdbOverhang 150 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--runThreadN 8</div>" style="shape=parallelogram;perimeter=parallelogramPerimeter;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fixedSize=1;align=left;size=-20;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="190" width="340" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="-tBO2DgtPleyKCgmbG-t-6" value="STAR map fastq to index to get bam" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="100" y="360" width="120" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="-tBO2DgtPleyKCgmbG-t-7" value="<div>FQ1=$FASTQ_DIR/${sample}_S1_L005_R1_001.fastq.gz</div><div>FQ2=$FASTQ_DIR/${sample}_S1_L005_R2_001.fastq.gz</div><div><br></div><div># STAR index path</div><div>index=/data/sbcs/GuoLab/backup/liq17/ref/STAR_index/STAR_151bpindex_hg38 # index genome using STAR 2.5.4&nbsp;</div><div><br></div><div># Create output directories</div><div>mkdir -p $WORK_DIR/$sample</div><div>output=$WORK_DIR/$sample</div><div>prefix=$sample</div><div><br></div><div>################################ run #################################################</div><div>START=$(date +%s)</div><div><br></div><div>STAR --runMode alignReads \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--runThreadN ${thread} \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--genomeDir ${index} \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--twopassMode Basic \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outFilterMultimapNmax 20 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--alignSJoverhangMin 8 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--alignSJDBoverhangMin 1 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outFilterMismatchNmax 999 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outFilterMismatchNoverLmax 0.04 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--alignIntronMin 20 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--alignIntronMax 1000000 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--alignMatesGapMax 1000000 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outFilterType BySJout \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outFilterScoreMinOverLread 0.33 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outFilterMatchNminOverLread 0.33 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--limitSjdbInsertNsj 1200000 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--readFilesIn $FQ1 $FQ2 \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--readFilesCommand zcat \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outFileNamePrefix ${output}/${prefix} \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outSAMstrandField intronMotif \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outFilterIntronMotifs None \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--alignSoftClipAtReferenceEnds Yes \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--quantMode TranscriptomeSAM GeneCounts \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outSAMtype BAM Unsorted \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outSAMunmapped Within \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--genomeLoad NoSharedMemory \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outSAMattributes NH HI AS nM NM ch \</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;--outSAMattrRGline ID:rg1 SM:sm1</div>" style="shape=parallelogram;perimeter=parallelogramPerimeter;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fixedSize=1;align=left;size=-20;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="350" width="340" height="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="-tBO2DgtPleyKCgmbG-t-8" value="samtool sort bam file and picard remove duplicates" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="110" y="1010" width="120" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="-tBO2DgtPleyKCgmbG-t-12" value="<div># Sort and index BAM</div><div>samtools sort --threads ${thread} ${output}/${prefix}.Aligned.out.bam -o ${output}/${prefix}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam</div><div>samtools index ${output}/${prefix}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam</div><div><br></div><div># Cleanup</div><div>rm ${output}/${prefix}.Aligned.out.bam</div><div><br></div><div># Save splice junction info</div><div># First line: keeps the first-pass splice junctions around.</div><div># Next three lines: compress splice junction + count outputs from STAR so you don’t waste space.</div><div>cp ${output}/${prefix}_STARpass1/SJ.out.tab ${output}/${sample}.SJ.pass1.out.tab</div><div>gzip ${output}/${sample}.SJ.pass1.out.tab</div><div>gzip ${output}/${prefix}SJ.out.tab</div><div>gzip ${output}/${prefix}ReadsPerGene.out.tab</div><div><br></div><div># Make duplicated alignments</div><div>java -Xmx16g -jar $EBROOTPICARD/picard.jar MarkDuplicates I=${output}/${prefix}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam O=${output}/${prefix}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.md.bam M=${output}/${prefix}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.md_metrics.txt</div><div>samtools index ${output}/${prefix}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.md.bam</div>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="1010" width="340" height="460" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="-tBO2DgtPleyKCgmbG-t-13" value="quantification RNA-seq expression" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="120" y="1510" width="120" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="-tBO2DgtPleyKCgmbG-t-14" value="<div>/data/sbcs/GuoLab/backup/liq17/biosoft/rnaseqc.v2.4.2.linux ${gtf_file} ${output}/${prefix}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.md.bam ${output} -s ${sample_id} --mapping-quality=255 --base-mismatch=6</div><div><br></div>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="1500" width="340" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
